description: issue #674 (SP2): the required C3 identity fixture SP1 could not write. `tell :friend` sets the addressed set to the freshly-spawned turtle, so `who` (the current turtle) reports `:friend`. Written unparenthesised because `print (who == :friend)` currently fails to parse (bug #709 — the reader commits to `parenthesized-call` when a callable name heads the parentheses). `who == :friend` is `true` because turtle `==` compares the stable id (C3, #665), not the JS wrapper, so a re-wrapped turtle still compares equal. Every change of the addressed set — here from `tell` — also emits the addressing `primitive` event carrying `addressing: { addressed_turtle_ids, current_turtle_id }`, so a consumer can identify the addressed turtle set (issue #766, spec/rendering.md:193); `ask`/`each` emit one again when the previous set is restored, on every exit path.
